The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] had enacted a '''law''', mandating that a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Imperial citizen must be inducted into the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="Secret of Cave 52">{{TORcite|type=faction|Empire|The Secret of Cave 52|Balmorra}}</ref> [[Kory]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into a low social class, was inducted into the Sith<ref name="Of Mind and Matter">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Of Mind and Matter|Korriban}}</ref> per this law.<ref name="Secret of Cave 52" />
